description: Reviewed mappings from a CNA's (vendor, product) pair or repository to the PyPI or npm package it publishes. agent_audit_kit/nvd_feed.py reads a row only for an NVD record whose CNA data carries no packageURL. Add a row only after checking that the package's own page on pypi.org or npmjs.com names the same project (its repository), never from a name alone, and set `reviewed` to that date.
